newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler raises incentives on several cars.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler raises incentives on several cars.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said Monday it increased cash incentives to $1,000 from $500 on 1997 model Dodge and Plymouth Neon, Plymouth Breeze, Dodge Stratus and Chrysler Cirrus cars.
The changes are effective October 8. Chrysler left rebate programs on other vehicles unchanged, but extended all of its incentives on 1996 and 1997 models through January 6, 1997.

Chrysler, which broke industry tradition by continuing its incentive programs into the new model year, is offering cash rebates on 1997 vehicles ranging from $500 for the Dodge Avenger, Chrysler Sebring and Eagle Talon coupes to $1,500 on the Chrysler LHS sedan.

Cash allowances available on 1996 models range from $200 on the Jeep Cherokee SE to $3,000 on the Chrysler LHS. Chrysler is offering $1,000 on the 1996 Neon, Cirrus, Stratus, Breeze and Dodge Intrepid, Eagle Vision ESi and Chrysler Concorde LX, among others. The automaker is not offering cash incentives on any 1997 Jeep models.
